nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm VP8L decode FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Identical resident frozen VP8L input. Independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode, output acquisition/disposal; native software webp decode, state reset, ARGB-to-RGBA conversion, owned output allocation/release. Native codec/conversion contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts every pixel. Padded native rows exposed without an extra packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation/encoding, hashing and validation excluded. Exact original RGBA, alpha and hidden RGB. One existing raster; no quality enumeration. This one frozen exact native encoder input exercises adaptive coding; no profile/strategy sweep. Live cancelable token, never signaled; token/source creation and disposal outside timing. Native has no equivalent cancellation setting; complete decode/conversion/owned output release remain timed.
